messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to use the get_stock_prices function to retrieve stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla over durations: 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. The function signature expects companies: string[], duration: string. But we need to call it multiple times? Or maybe we can pass all companies and one duration? The user says "retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration". They want separate durations per company? Actually they say "for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon and Tesla respectively in 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks and 1 month time ranges." That implies each company has its own duration: Apple - 1 week, Microsoft - 2 weeks, Amazon - 3 weeks, Tesla - 1 month. So we need to call the function four times with single company each and respective duration.

We should ask clarifying question: do they want separate calls or combined? We can interpret as separate calls. We'll ask if they'd like separate calls or aggregated. Then proceed accordingly.
